hook: A player can build a triangle factor in a semi-random graph in at most 2.929329n rounds.

readout.label: Upper bound to build a triangle factor

summary: In a game where random vertices are offered and the player picks partners, the authors give a strategy that covers all vertices with disjoint triangles within 2.929329n rounds with high probability. This is a proof of an upper bound by analysis of a specific strategy. It does not show the bound is the best possible.
title: Triangle Factors in the Semi-Random Graph Process
